definitions.explanation: The central character in a story, novel, film, game, or other narrative. Can also refer figuratively to the central person in a real-life situation.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{物語|ものがたり}→物語：03634_monogatari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{主人公|しゅじんこう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{少女|しょうじょ}→少女：03233_shoujo⟧だ。
examples.english: The protagonist of this story is a girl.

examples.japanese: {主人公|しゅじんこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{感情移入|かんじょういにゅう}→感情移入：12845_kanjouinyuu⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I ended up emotionally identifying with the main character.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{主人公|しゅじんこう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{決断|けつだん}→決断：13250_ketsudan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The protagonist of that film makes a big decision at the end.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {主人公|しゅじんこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{演|えん}じる→演じる：13330_enjiru⟧ (to play the lead role)
- ⟦{物語|ものがたり}→物語：03634_monogatari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{主人公|しゅじんこう} (the protagonist of a story)
- {主人公|しゅじんこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{感情移入|かんじょういにゅう}→感情移入：12845_kanjouinyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to identify with the main character)

USAGE: {主人公|しゅじんこう} is the standard literary and conversational term for the lead character of any narrative. It is used for novels, manga, anime, films, and games alike. In figurative use, ⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{主人公|しゅじんこう} means "the protagonist of one's own life."
